subject: POC MAP Kickoff — success metrics, benchmarks & eval ownership (Nimbus HealthTech)
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: POC MAP Kickoff — success metrics, benchmarks & eval ownership (Nimbus HealthTech)

Hi Elena — great to meet you on the call earlier. Per our conversation, I wanted to kick off a concise mutual action plan (MAP) for the POC so we have clear success criteria, benchmark tests, and explicit owners for prompts and evaluation work. Goal is to complete the evaluation within 6 weeks and give your product team the data they need to make a go/no-go decision.

High-level proposed MAP sections (attached draft):
- Objectives & success criteria: what must be true at POC close for Nimbus to consider production-ready.
- Benchmarks & test harness: sample dataset, throughput/latency targets, quality metrics (precision/recall/F1 where appropriate), and evaluation prompts.
- Owners & cadence: who owns prompt development, evaluation runs, and issue triage.
- Timeline & gates: milestone dates, acceptance gates, and rollback triggers.

Proposed initial owners from Redwood:
- Prompts & evaluation design: Ben Carter
- Metric instrumentation & infra: Jordan Blake
- Quality monitoring & regression checks: Tessa Morgan

Please find the MAP draft and a spreadsheet with suggested benchmark tests attached (nimbus_map_draft_v1.pdf, nimbus-eval-benchmarks.xlsx). Can you confirm your primary stakeholders and any internal constraints (PHI handling, review committee windows) so we can finalize scope?

Next step: short alignment call Thursday 8/5 at 10:00am PT — does that work for your team?

Best,
Avery
Avery Johnson
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference

Attachment: nimbus_map_draft_v1.pdf (1 page — MAP overview)
Attachment: nimbus-eval-benchmarks.xlsx (spreadsheet — proposed tests)
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@nimbushealth.com>

Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC MAP Kickoff — success metrics, benchmarks & eval ownership (Nimbus HealthTech)

Thanks Avery — appreciate the clear outline. Quick answers from our side:

Stakeholders to include:
- Product & Clinical lead: Carlos Mendez (cc'd) — will own acceptance decisions.
- Data & Security lead: Priya Shah <priya.shah@nimbushealth.com> (she'll be looped shortly) — needs SOC 2 evidence and data retention details.
- Evaluation SME: Elena Rossi (myself) — will coordinate sample selection and domain prompts.

Constraints/notes:
- Sample dataset will be de-identified but still counts as regulated data; need explicit KMS and audit log confirmation.
- Acceptance criteria: prefer receiving both quantitative benchmarks (accuracy on labeled holdouts) and a qualitative clinical review for edge cases.
- Target timeline: Nimbus needs go/no-go decision by end of Sep (makes your 6-week window tight but possible if we start this week).

Thursday 8/5 10:00am PT works for Carlos and me. I'll bring a short list of clinical use cases we want prioritized.

Thanks — Elena
Elena Rossi
Director, Clinical Innovation
Nimbus HealthTech

Elena/Avery — following up with a concrete benchmark plan and owner assignments so we can finalize at Thursday's call. See bullets below and the attached spreadsheet for the test matrix.

Benchmark plan (high level):
1) Quality: labeled holdout (n=1k samples) — target: micro-F1 >= 0.82 across primary entity extraction tasks.
2) Clinical safety/regression: 50 edge-case prompts curated by Nimbus + 50 synthetic edge prompts — pass/fail with reviewer notes.
3) Latency & throughput: 95th percentile latency < 320ms for typical prompt size (avg 150 tokens), batch sizes up to 16.
4) Cost: projected per-1k-token inference cost using Redwood quantized model profiles (estimations in sheet).

Owner assignments (Redwood):
- Prompt authoring & bench harness: Ben Carter (primary), Tessa Morgan (secondary reviewer)
- Eval runs & metric aggregation: Jordan Blake
- Error triage & root cause: Ben + Jordan (shared)

Owner assignments (Nimbus expectation):
- Clinical review & acceptance: Carlos Mendez (primary)
- Data sample provisioning & de-id verification: Priya Shah

Pre-reads for Thursday: please review the attached test matrix and indicate any additional clinical edge cases we should include. We'll lock the MAP's acceptance gates on the call.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference

Thanks team — thumbs up from Nimbus on the proposed owners and benchmarks. A couple of quick asks before the call:

- Please add a single-line summary in the MAP that calls out our absolute must-haves: no PHI leakage, clear audit logs for all inference calls, and an emergency rollback plan.
- Can Redwood confirm KMS key flow and whether the audit logs show token-level request IDs? Our security team wants that detail in writing.

I'll bring three prioritized clinical scenarios to the call. Also attached our internal acceptance rubric (nimbus-acceptance-rubric.pdf) — it maps to the quantitative and qualitative checks you proposed.

See you Thursday 10am PT.

Carlos
Carlos Mendez
VP Product & Clinical Ops
Nimbus HealthTech
